test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No Improvement'.**

Keep the dog tied indoors; __however__, it may bite some stranger.
solution:
The correct answer is **else**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The use of **'****however' **is incorrect here.
 
• **However: **In spite of that; nevertheless.
 
• **Else: **otherwise.
 
• The use of **'****else' **is more appropriate here.
 
• Hence, the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence is **option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *Keep the dog tied indoors; __**else**__, it may bite some stranger.*
